any place it desires. However, it can
be blown away by wind.

that a Gengar has appeared.

echoes a long way.

It rarely eats the dreams of adults
because children's are much tastier.

los de los niños son más sabrosos.

in anyone nearby.

pincers grow back if they are torn out of
their sockets.

pincer. The pincers size makes it difficult
to aim properly.

dificulta apuntar con precisión.

Selfdestruct.

stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname

some sort, it was discovered to be a
life-form more like plant seeds.

appear to squabble.

bien y nunca parecen discutir.

de Marowak en algún lugar.
